Lina — thanks for the files. Looping in Marissa (AP onboarding) and Karthik (vendor master ops) so we can finish setup.

Quick checklist for us to complete the vendor master: 
1) Confirm legal entity name to appear on vendor profile and POs (exact spelling and punctuation).
2) Provide tax classification and EIN (you already included EIN — will we need any state tax ID?).
3) Confirm bank routing or indicate whether payments will be via ACH/Virtual Card; if ACH, we'll need a voided check/bank letter (we can accept redacted PDF).
4) Confirm remit email and whether KelPTech requires invoices to be submitted to a portal (e.g., Ariba, Coupa) or emailed to ap@kelptech.com.
5) Primary PO recipient: name/email/phone for buyer-facing contact—this determines PO acceptance routing.

Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm timing on how soon we can create the vendor record after Lina returns items 1–4? Any required template fields from Finance side I should flag to Lina now?

If it's helpful, Lina, I can send our vendor onboarding form (minimal) and a short PO terms summary.

Thanks,
– Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan and Lina — copied Karthik for master-data steps. Lina, welcome. A few items from AP and vendor management to keep the pipeline moving: 

Inventory of items we need to create the vendor master (order matters):
- Confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on PO: 
  -> "KelPTech Incorporated" (please confirm capitalization/punctuation).
- Completed onboarding form (you already sent, will review).
- W-9 (received).
- Remittance routing preference (ACH preferred). If ACH: bank letter or voided check.
- Primary AP contact for invoice mismatch/PO exceptions (name + direct phone).
- If you require a non-standard payment term (Net45, CWT), note that now — standard Redwood terms are Net30 unless vendor requests otherwise and Finance approves.

Karthik — once Lina confirms the exact legal name and remittance method, can Ops create the vendor in the master and assign the default PO delivery email? Also flag if we need tax residency docs for international entities (not required here, but good to note).

Lina, I attached our one-page vendor intake we prefer completed when possible — it reduces back-and-forth. Also note: if KelPTech will store or process Redwood customer data (e.g., on integrated devices), we may need an NDA or DPA; let us know.

Next steps: Lina confirms the two small outstanding items (legal name confirmation and remit file). We aim to have vendor live within 3 business days after bank proof and legal-name confirmation.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
